variants.title: DC generator with a split-ring commutator: emf against speed
variants.sample: Generic demonstration generator with a commutator
variants.aim: Turn the coil of a demonstration generator fitted with a split-ring commutator, watch the one-way pulsating emf on an oscilloscope, and find N B A from the peak emf at several speeds.

source.title: University of Delhi B.Sc. (Hons.) Physics practical lists (LOCF 2019 / UGCF 2022)
